text:
devon: Heads up: CI integration job (hosted api suite) is red. Failing tests: auth header mismatch, streaming connection drops, and tool-call 502s. Reported on run: https://ci.redwood/gh/1234/jobs/5678 :eyes:
ci-bot: CI report attached — 3 failing tests in integration/hosted/* (see logs). Rerun available.
maria: @devon can you paste the failing stack for auth? is it a token format change or something from the mock auth service?
devon: Here's the auth snippet from the failing test run:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"missing X-Client-Auth header"}
...
stream error: io: read/write on closed pipe -> "stream closed by peer"
toolcall: 502 Bad Gateway - upstream EOF
```
Also note CI uses REDWOOD_HOSTED_API_URL and REDWOOD_API_KEY from secrets.
ashley: I noticed pr #3421 tightened header parsing in the auth middleware — didn't expect it to break hosted tests. @noah can you bisect between main and that PR? :mag:
noah: On it. Starting git bisect across last 24 commits now. quick q: does the integration runner hit staging or the emulator? that changes repro steps.
devon: Runner hits staging (staging.redwood.ai) by default unless CI_OVERRIDE_HOST is set. I reproduced failing auth locally against both staging and emulator.
maria: Local repro steps (worked for me):
export CI_OVERRIDE_HOST=staging.redwood.ai
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=staging-key-xxx
pytest tests/integration/test_hosted_auth.py::test_auth_header -q -s
(no mocks)
noah: Bisect result: commit 9b1f2a3 changed header parsing. Quick patch to accept legacy header makes tests pass locally. I'll open a revert/compat PR.
ashley: Great. Add a compatibility shim + unit test. I'll file separate issues for the streaming disconnect and the toolcall 502 (likely unrelated race and upstream timeout).
devon: Thanks — I'll wait for the shim PR then rerun full integration suite. @ci-bot can you rerun job 5678 with CI_RERUN_NOTE="bisect revert test"? :pray:
ci-bot: Rerun requested — job 5678 (rerun 5678.2) queued. Posting results when finished.
sre-oncall: FYI I'll monitor staging and the routing tier. If errors spike >5% I'll roll back the last deploy. Ping me with infra logs or alert links. :eyes:
